---
title: "Collection table"
format: 
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| label: main-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| 

library(dplyr)
library(DT)

source("helpers.R")

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv", check.names = FALSE)

datatable(dat[, c("ID", "Tick species", "Publication year", "ArticleTitle", "City", "DOI", "LID")], ,
          escape = FALSE, 
          style = "bootstrap5",
          class = "wrap",
          filter = "top",
          extensions = c("Select", "SearchPanes", "Buttons"), 
          selection = "none",
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 50,
            dom = "PBfrtip",
            buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
            searchPanes = list(initCollapsed = TRUE, viewCount = TRUE),
            columnDefs = list(
              list(targets = c(0, 2L:3, 5L:6), searchPanes = list(show = FALSE)),
              list(targets = 0, render = render_collection),
              list(targets = 1, 
                   searchPanes = list(show = TRUE, orthogonal = "sp"),
                   render = render_small_items_in_searchPanes),
              list(targets = 3, render = render_publication_doi(5)),
              list(targets = 4, render = render_city_lid(6)),
              list(targets = c(5L:6), visible = FALSE)
            )
          )
)

```
